weakest_check.expected: should fail; doctor test only compares empty vs fully installed HOME

findings.detail: Identity split: MCP server entry has no env, so MCP tools act as mcp@<folder> while hooks/monitor use claude@<folder>. Add env PARLEY_HARNESS=claude (or PARLEY_AGENT_ID) to the MCP entry and test it.
Plugin loading unverified: a folder in ~/.claude/plugins/<name> is not loaded (confirmed from official docs, see plugin-loading.md); doctor reports can-wake-idle from file existence only.
PostToolUse registered twice (with Edit matcher and without); edits processed twice.
session-end requeues delivered messages across all sessions of the agent (exceptSession=null), not just the ending session; untested.

monitor.sh exits for good if the agent isn't registered yet (race with SessionStart); SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit print status lines into model context; fake adapter still in production ADAPTERS list (real setup writes ~/.parley-fake/). Also unrecorded: Stop hook uses last_assistant_message as read evidence (beyond PLAN 4.3).
